passages.context: Under 'Dominica XIa post octabas Pentecosten', no. 478, Post communionem, begins 'Quesumus domine deus noster ut quos tuis reparare non...' and is cross-referenced in this edition to SupG 1162. Nos. 476–477 carry the corresponding Collect and Secret.
